Indian-origin former Google executive fatally shot in US; husband arrested

An Indian-origin former Google executive, identified as Sheetal Wrzesien, was fatally shot at her home in the US. Her husband has been arrested in connection with the incident, and her son was also injured. Wrzesien had over two decades of experience as an engineering leader at Google. The motive is suggested to be a domestic dispute.
